text:
What really caused the Air Busan A321 fire?

An unidentified object in an overhead luggage compartment is now the focus of investigations into the Air Busan A321 registered HL7763 flight #BX391 call sign #ABL391 ,fire at Gimhae International Airport.

Passengers and flight attendants reported seeing smoke coming from an overhead bin. A couple sitting nearby recalled a flight attendant asking, “What did you put inside?” just before thick smoke filled the cabin.

Initial speculation pointed to the Auxiliary Power Unit (APU), but eyewitness accounts suggest otherwise.

With 176 passengers evacuated and seven injured, the big question remains: What exactly ignited the fire?
